_meta.description: Match a look you love, then keep every slider. Curves, a colour mixer, masks, crop and lens correction, retouching and burst culling — all on device, all non-destructive, all inside the Photos app.
_title: Luma Editor - A Photo Editor That Matches Your Style
a-look-you-love.36fd0c: A Look You Love, and the Controls to Change It
a-match-hands-you.2415c2: A match hands you real sliders, not a strength dial. Light, Color, Detail and Effects, four-channel tone curves, an eight-band colour mixer, split toning, and a proper black-and-white conversion where the mixer acts as the channel mix. Undo and redo step through your edits one at a time.
a-starting-point-not.c46959: A Starting Point, Not a Finish Line
a-style-match-used.dad958: A style match used to end in pixels. Now it arrives as adjustments you own, with a whole editor around them.
adjust-part-of-the.79f725: Adjust part of the photo instead of all of it. Linear and radial gradients you place by dragging, luminance and colour ranges, and Subject, Background and People found on device. Each mask gets its own complete set of adjustments — and a style can be matched to one mask alone, your subject against their subject.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
can-i-edit-photos.d6c2b7: Can I edit photos in bulk?
can-i-fine-tune.813f47: Can I fine-tune a match afterwards?
crop-by-dragging-the.a61c92: Crop by dragging the corners, straighten by hand or let Luma find the horizon on device, correct the perspective of a building shot from below, and fix what the glass did — radial distortion, chromatic aberration and colour fringing. Rotate and flip in quarter turns.
cull-a-burst-edit.4a00dc: Cull a Burst, Edit a Clip
develop-a-whole-shoot.5d32b2: Develop a whole shoot at once and Luma matches each photo to the closest style, so an afternoon's work comes out consistent without a preset being forced onto pictures it does not suit.
does-it-work-with.2fe73c: Does it work with my Photos library?
drag-the-corners-with.4d8b75: Drag the corners with a thirds grid and aspect presets. Straighten by hand or find the horizon automatically. Correct the perspective of something tall shot from below. Lens distortion, chromatic aberration and defringe handle what the glass did.
exposure-brilliance-highlights-shado.f44: Exposure, Brilliance, Highlights, Shadows, Contrast, Black Point, White Point, Saturation, Vibrance, Warmth, Tint, Sharpness, Definition, Noise Reduction, Vignette and Grain — plus four-channel tone curves, an eight-band colour mixer and split toning. Intensity now scales the adjustments themselves, so every slider stays meaningful at any setting.
hand-luma-a-burst.ed0f07: Hand Luma a burst and it groups the near-duplicates and suggests which to keep, measuring focus, whether eyes are open, and what is clipped or flat. The picks land in a Luma Keepers album, best first. The choice stays yours, and nothing is ever deleted.
how-does-luma-editor.e924f8: How does Luma Editor match photo styles?
is-luma-editor-available.7b7ea5: Is Luma Editor available in the European Union?
it-handles-the-part.c0bb06: It handles the part of a burst nobody enjoys. Luma groups the near-duplicates, measures each frame for focus, face capture quality and clipping, and suggests which one to keep — then files the picks into a Luma Keepers album, best first, so you can find them in Photos afterwards. Every pick is a suggestion you can change, and nothing is ever deleted.
luma-adds-itself-to.609faf: Luma adds itself to the Photos editing screen too: tap Edit, then the extensions button, then Luma, and the whole editor is there on that photo — or on that video. Or take a look elsewhere entirely, as Camera Raw settings for Lightroom or as a 3D LUT.
luma-edits-in-place.c94f27: Luma edits in place the way Photos does. Your original is never touched, Revert to Original always works, edits sync through iCloud Photos, and reopening a photo brings back every slider exactly where you left it — not a flattened picture to start over from.
luma-measures-how-the.16c5cd: Luma measures how the photo you picked actually looks — its tonal distribution, its colour balance, how it treats each family of hues, what it does in the shadows and the highlights — and then solves for the adjustments that move your photo there. The answer comes back as sliders, curves and a colour mixer you can go on editing, not as a finished picture.
luma-studies-the-photo.a733b3: Luma studies the photo you picked — its tone, its colour, how it handles shadows and highlights — and solves for the adjustments that get your photo there. What you get back is the recipe, not the result.
luts-lookup-tables-are.f85b9f: LUTs (Lookup Tables) are colour grading presets that other apps can read. Luma generates a real 3D LUT (.cube) from your edit by running an identity lattice through its own renderer, so what you export matches what is on screen — ready for Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve. You can also export as Camera Raw XMP for Lightroom. Neither format can carry masks or retouching, and Luma tells you when an export is leaving something behind.
match-a-look-keep.1134b2: Match a Look. Keep Every Slider.
no-luma-edits-non.7d9ff4: No. Luma edits non-destructively through the Photos library: your original file is never touched, Revert to Original always works, edits sync through iCloud Photos, and reopening a photo in Luma restores every slider exactly where you left it rather than starting again from the rendered result.
point-luma-at-a.aafe01: Point Luma at a photo whose look you love and it works out how to get yours there — then hands you the result as real adjustments you can keep editing. Curves, a colour mixer, masks, crop and lens correction, retouching, and burst culling. All on device, all non-destructive, all the way inside the Photos app.
point-luma-at-a.f8bf21: Point Luma at a burst and it groups the near-duplicates and suggests the keeper, weighing focus against whether eyes are open. Picks are filed into a Luma Keepers album, best first, so you can find them in Photos — and nothing is ever deleted. Video edits the same way a photo does, straight from the Photos editing screen.
save-a-look-as.1631f0: Save a look as a named preset, or copy one photo's look and paste it onto the next. Presets leave the framing behind — a crop belongs to the photo it was drawn on. Auto Enhance is there when you just want somewhere to start.
save-the-photos-whose.cf17e2: Save the photos whose look you want as styles. Luma studies one, works out how to get your photo there, and applies it — so a whole shoot can come out looking like your last one, or like the photographer you are learning from.
so-the-interesting-part.38621d: So the interesting part starts where a filter would stop. Warm it a little further, pull the highlights back, lift only the blues, or match the look to your subject and leave the background alone. It is your edit from the first tap.
start-from-a-photo.13d5f0: Start from a photo whose grade you admire — your own or someone else's — and finish it your way.
tap-a-blemish-and.1b2d81: Tap a blemish and it goes, with clean skin or sky found nearby to replace it — and stored as an adjustment, so you can move it or take it away a month later. Masks put an adjustment on part of the photo instead of all of it: gradients you drag on the image, luminance and colour ranges, or the subject and the people, found on device.
tap-a-blemish-and.4366a9: Tap a blemish and it goes. Luma finds clean skin or sky nearby to replace it with, and you can drag the source elsewhere if you disagree. Spots are stored as adjustments rather than baked into the picture, so a repair can be moved, resized or undone any time.
tap-a-blemish-and.6e8340: Tap a blemish and it goes. Luma finds clean skin or sky nearby to replace it with, and you can drag the source somewhere else if you disagree. Spots are stored as adjustments rather than painted into the picture, so a repair can be moved, resized or removed months later like any other slider.
that-is-the-point.42317c: That is the point of it. Every match lands as ordinary adjustments — Light, Color, Detail, Effects, tone curves, the colour mixer, split toning — and you can change any of them, add masks, crop, retouch, and undo step by step. The Intensity control scales the adjustments themselves rather than fading a finished picture over your original, so the sliders stay meaningful at any setting.
what-are-luts-and.ad0f3e: What are LUTs and how do I use them?
yes-and-inside-it.11f9fe: Yes, and inside it. Luma adds itself to the Photos editing screen — tap Edit, then the extensions button, then Luma — so the whole editor, your saved styles and your presets are available on a photo or video without leaving Photos.
yes-develop-a-whole.a0c3a0: Yes. Develop a whole shoot at once and Luma matches each photo to the closest style, so the results are consistent without one preset being forced onto pictures it does not suit. Save a look as a named preset, or copy a look from one photo and paste it onto the next.
yes-from-the-photos.40ae4a: Yes, from the Photos editing screen. Open a clip, tap Edit, then the extensions button, then Luma, and the framing, tone, colour, curves, colour mixer and gradient and range masks all apply to every frame. Content-aware masks are left out of motion — a segmentation recomputed per frame visibly crawls, and approximating it would look worse than not offering it.
yes-luma-editor-is.3b1eca: Yes. Luma Editor is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
